question: Which of the following is the total value of goods and services produced by a country during a financial year?
solution:
The correct answer is __**National income.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• National Income is the total monetary value of goods and services produced within the territory of the country in a given period of time.
